notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:
This update introduces two more characters and begins to introduce the player to the main story of the game. You can also save and load game files now, WOOHOO!!! Here is a quick breakdown of the new features added in this latest version:
 

 The game now starts in full screen
 New fonts for character messages
 Added NPC character Jenny Nguyen to the game
 Added NPC character Dhani Anand to the game
 Additions to Main Story
 Character Trent Bishop has some animation
 Character Jenny Nguyen has some animation
 Character Dhani Anand has some animation
 Started NPC Behavior Trees
 Player can now choose their name when talking to NPC Dhani Anand
 Player can now select a job title, which will add bonus skills and or traits in future updates, when talking to NPC Dhani Anand
 Pressing Escape now pauses the game
 Started Save/Load system
 Added option to quit to menu to pause menu
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.2.15
notes.notes:
Got a lot done this month so far, and wanted to put in a bonus update mid month.


 Added Day/Night cycle
 Map now shows user location - NOTE the mini map is still very much early state and will change to a better and more useful state soon
 Added a full inventory and build menu that can be accessed by pressing Tab button
     NOTE: Instructions for use are coming soon, but should be fairly intuitive using Mouse buttons
 Added three craftable items
 Axe can be crafted to chop down tall Birch trees
 Started a Game Menu that can be accessed by pressing Escape button
 Crafted items can be equipped using mouse buttons while in Inventory Menu or by utilizing keys 1-8 on keyboard when placed in the top row of the Inventory

notes.title: Major Update - New Game Base
notes.notes:
It has been a long time since I have last made changes to this game. The world has seen some pretty crazy stuff, and I have been working on other projects. and now... WHX is back!

In the spirit of brevity here are the things you need to know:

[olist]
 This latest update is the start of a brand-new build of the game
 I will release a new update at the end of each month until WHX is feature complete
 Because this is the first release of the new build, and there isn't anything to actually do in the game as it stands, I will likely release twice in the months of February and March, so keep yours eyes peeled
[/olist]

Thank you everyone for your patience, and I look forward to developing something fun and exciting for you all to enjoy.

Please stand by...

notes.notes:

Updates:

 Full controller support
 A brand new crafting system
 Beginning cave area now contains a Recipe Creation Tutorial
 New GUI and HUD system
 New Dialogue system, completely redone from scratch
 Lots of code optimization for better performance on all platforms
 General performance increased
 Player movement speed increased further
 Character Design improvements


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that broke the game when right trigger was pressed
 Fixed a bug that stopped player movement from being restored when not in menus
 Fixed some alerting text bugs
 Lots of general bug fixes throughout the game


The takeaway for CU3 is the new Recipe Creation Tutorial. This should help clear up any issues or confusion that people had with this main game mechanic. Because of this new tutorial all previous character saves will no longer work. Please delete any old characters. **We debated for a time about this, but ultimately decided that because we're in EA we should focus more on additional content rather than backwards compatibility. If anyone has concerns please speak up and we will do our best to address them. More fun stuff in the coming weeks, so keep watching, and thanks!

notes.title: Content Update 2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34106576/532c53a038c4348eafacb4f037c9527ac4396142.png

Updates:
- General performance increased
- Player movement speed increased
- Players can now buy two plots of land from the Mayor
- Inventory item quantity is now displayed centered over the bottom of the item
- Player created items are now assigned item values for selling at the general goods store
- Character Creation Updates

 Character randomization button added
 A randomized character will be generated for new characters and can be edited normally
 Recipes are no longer globally shared between characters
 Deleting a character card will now also delete all of that characters recipes

- Recipe Updates

 If a player creates a recipe and doesn't save before exiting the game, that recipe is now also not saved
 If a player deletes a recipe and then exits the game without saving that recipe will not be deleted
 Included recipes can be deleted (but cannot be recovered once this is done)

- General monster AI behavior improvements 

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that stopped shop menu from opening after the first time
- Fixed a bug that broke the drop-equip feature which allows the player to drop an item onto her/himself to equip it
- Fixed a bug that caused an error while opening transaction menu INI files
- Fixed a bug that caused chests to be empty upon new character creation
- Fixed a bug that prevented player from mining resources below 
- Fixed a bug that prevented the player from attacking monsters below
- Fixed a bug that stopped message boxes from closing
- Fixed a bug that stopped zombies from changing back to normal when player is out of attack range

The biggest thing to take away from this update is the new save/load system. Because of this new system all previous character saves and recipes will no longer work. Please delete any old characters. We debated for a time about this, but ultimately decided that because we're in EA we should focus more on additional content rather than backwards compatibility. If anyone has concerns please speak up and we will do our best to address them. Thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34106576/9517171f60a101944cc85c05d1b20c2682508dd0.png

notes.title: Content Update 1
notes.notes:
First content update!!!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/d5b8d8b8fb19ba5b8305a14cdfa33bb784ebcf3a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/d5b8d8b8fb19ba5b8305a14cdfa33bb784ebcf3a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/d5b8d8b8fb19ba5b8305a14cdfa33bb784ebcf3a.png

We got a lot accomplished and we had fun doing it! A special thanks to everyone who sent in their experiences and opinions. We tried to address every comment and concern no matter how big or small. With this first content update we started a lot of new features, so keep an eye out for yours. 

General Updates:

 Better rain system
 Tree collision improved
 Compass added for tracking goals and quests
 More even snow during winter
 No longer Snows indoors
 No longer rains indoors
 Fall season added to game
 Weapon damage has been reduced for balancing
 Workbenches no longer break the game when browsing multiple recipe possibilities
 A sample farm has been added with Melon, Pumpkin, Lettuce, and Tomatoes


Design Mechanic Updates:

 Close button added (pressing escape will still allow you to exit)
 Fix: can no longer zoom in or out while using the Design Mechanic
 Improved maths for better FPS
 Can change size of item and the position it equips to on the player


Enemy Updates:

 Zombie health has been raised for balancing
 Snake attack and general behavior tweaks
 Loot drops must now pass a coin flip to be created
 Snakes now spawn in desert chunks


NPC Updates:

 Most NPC characters got a make over
 NPC Trent added
 Trent is the mayor of the our humble town



Despite everything we got done, there is still a lot more to come! 

Team SeacreatureSandwich got some hardware upgrades including a new workstation, new GPU, server, and monitors. We're upgrading our tech, so we can better support the players (that's you!!!).

We hope everyone is enjoying the game so far and we look forward to many more content updates!

notes.title: EA Release Day!!!
notes.notes:
Merry Release Day!!!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/8e6a7de1f6d82f19ab82e88a008aecd4011bac2c.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/e52e8e52cd9c05718a79e0e9c5a3f34cd4a08d04.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/624678b8799b595a29192c228994b58e8f9da5c5.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/2c0dcfd5e6599913f59411ea0dbe2c49a9fe09a7.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/8e6a7de1f6d82f19ab82e88a008aecd4011bac2c.png

We wanted to start out by wishing everyone pleasant winter holidays, and say thanks to anyone who has considered purchasing and helping contribute to Werewolf Hunter X. 

We just hit the Release button! What a super awesome thing to do! It’s Early Access release, but it is still a VERY cool thing to do.

It’s going to be a long process, but we will fill the time with feedback requests, content updates, bug fixes, contests, and more. Our goal is to ensure the Early Access period of Werewolf Hunter X is fun and exciting for everyone! 

The first thing we’d like to do is get a feel from the community as to what we should be focusing our efforts on for the coming content update. There are a lot of unfinished mechanics, features, art, and plot, so your ideas are welcomed and appreciated.

We're sure there will be a good amount of bug reports, and we will address those as quickly as possible, with game breaking bugs taking a priority, so don’t worry if you run into one. Let us know by responding here or even by sending an email to Support@SeaCreatureSandwich.com.

We are very excited to hear your thoughts and ideas. Thanks!

The SeaCreatureSandwich Team
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34106576/9517171f60a101944cc85c05d1b20c2682508dd0.png
